scope: Snapshot inventory of all current exposed source-catalog pointers in dist/data.json that share (a) the exact historical image hashes of Assassin regions repaired in this working tree, (b) the exact PHB p.33 old/current region geometry, or (c) exact current Assassin image bytes. This is a candidate denominator and semantic triage, not an image review or blanket approval. No old image bytes are copied into this artifact.

denominator.method: Traverse every nested catalog pointer in every array record in dist/data.json; de-duplicate record/catalog ownership while retaining pointer paths; load each exposed dist catalog and enumerate every region.

historicalAssassinBaseline.note: The audit records four prior Assassin image hashes: PHB pp.27, 32, 33 and 28. These exact hash matches are checked across all currently exposed catalogs.

phb33RegionGeometryInventory.sourceFinding: PHB p.33 two-class worked example begins in the lower-left column and completes at the top of the right column on the same printed p.33/PDF p.34. The right-column continuation is part of the worked example and belongs in an ordered second segment when this general rule/example is the cited scope.

workedExampleSourceGeometry.rightColumnContinuationText: Completes the Fighter-to-Magic-user worked example, including the new-class hit die and class-function/armor restrictions, then ends before the ALIGNMENT heading.
workedExampleSourceGeometry.boundaryFinding: Current Assassin left excerpt bottom is at about y=678.0 pt and excludes the example start at y=679.6 pt; the historical taller left crop bottom at about y=749.0 pt contains the complete left-side example opening through y=742.0 pt. The complete example requires the ordered same-page right-column continuation.
workedExampleSourceGeometry.status: source bounds measured for review planning only; no catalog or crop applied.

triage.p33GenericTwoClassContext: All current class-card uses of the old PHB p.33 image point to the same generic two-class advancement procedure; it is relevant as general context, but each card still needs its own source-claim/eligibility assessment. The separate rules:dual-class catalog is directly scoped to that procedure. The p.33 alignment and multiclass-equipment crops are different regions and excluded from this continuation candidate denominator.
triage.phb32MultiClassContext: The PHB p.32 exact image is a multi-class explanation/examples excerpt. It may support class-combination background but each class combination and context remains uncertain until reviewed; no group approval inferred.
triage.phb28ThiefFunctionTable: The PHB p.28 exact image is the thief-function table. It is a baseline candidate for thief/monk/UA barbarian/thief-acrobat records; the class-specific link from table to rules is unresolved per catalog summaries.
triage.phb27ThiefAcrobat: The PHB p.27 old image is used by the UA Thief-acrobat catalog as a thief-function baseline; likely related, but exact UA application/context remains separately unreviewed.
triage.exactByteReuseOfCurrentAssassinImages: Some currently approved/reviewed Assassin sources are shared byte-for-byte with other class/spell catalogs. Those are inventory only; a future crop change must assess every linked item, and their review states do not transfer.

limitations: This denominator covers only catalogs referenced by nested catalog pointers in the current dist/data.json snapshot. It does not enumerate unreferenced catalog files or source passages with no catalog link.
Exact-byte and rectangle matches locate possible shared source-image instances; they do not prove that each item relies on or is adequately supported by the same excerpt.
No permission or approval is inherited from a shared image, prior row review, or another class entry.
Historical image bytes are not included; their actual SHA-256 and Git catalog object identities are retained.
